🧠 Crypto News Brief: Regulation is shifting from a stalled Congress to an activist SEC as institutions deepen their crypto footprint — yet prices wobble, with Bitcoin sliding below $64K on oil-driven macro fears and returning ETF outflows ahead of Wednesday's CPI. ⚖️ SEC Sets Aug. 14 Vote on Landmark 'Regulation Crypto' The SEC will hold an open meeting Friday to decide whether to propose "Regulation Crypto," a tailored offering framework that would let token projects raise capital without triggering full securities registration — and define when a project exits SEC jurisdiction. It's Chair Paul Atkins' first formal crypto rulemaking, and the all-Republican commission is expected to advance it to public comment. Read full story 🏛️ Senate Leaves Town Without CLARITY Act Vote, Eyes Sept. 15 The U.S. Senate departed for its August recess without even a procedural vote on the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act, pushing a cloture motion to Sept. 15. The delay strips crypto of a hoped-for legislative catalyst and hands near-term momentum to the SEC's own rulemaking track. More details 🌍 Coinbase Wins Abu Dhabi License for Global Tokenization Hub Coinbase secured a Financial Services Permission from Abu Dhabi Global Market's FSRA to arrange deals and custody tokenized securities, making ADGM its international tokenization base outside the U.S. The tokens will be fully backed by underlying shares, carry voting and dividend rights, and trade straight from a wallet — no brokerage account required. Read more 📉 Strategy Sells Another 1,690 BTC to Fund STRC Buyback Michael Saylor's Strategy sold 1,690 BTC for $108.6M between Aug. 3–9 — its second straight week of sales — using the proceeds to repurchase STRC preferred stock and lift its USD reserve to $4.65B. The firm still holds 840,447 BTC, but repeat selling from crypto's largest corporate holder weighed on sentiment. See details 🏦 Bitcoin-Backed Lending Enters Its Institutional Era Public companies are increasingly borrowing against their bitcoin rather than selling it: MARA pledged 18,750 BTC (~$1.2B) to secure $600M in term loans from Coinbase Credit and Two Prime. Lenders now offer larger, longer and more bespoke facilities — a sign BTC-collateralized credit is maturing into a TradFi-style product. Read full story 🛢️ Bitcoin Slips Below $64K as Hormuz Stalemate Squeezes Market Bitcoin fell about 1.7% ov
